q: How do I book a studio session or wedding?
a: A 50% deposit secures your studio session. For weddings and major events, a 50% non-refundable deposit secures your date on our calendar. The remaining balance is due before final delivery. Bookings are confirmed directly on WhatsApp (+234 816 820 4080).

q: How quickly will I receive my edited pictures?
a: Studio portraits are edited and delivered within 24 hours of your picture selection. Same-day express delivery: +₦500 per picture. For weddings, highlight films are delivered within 1 week, and edited wedding photos are delivered within 3–4 weeks after the wedding.

q: Where is your studio located and what are your opening hours?
a: Our studio is located at 82 De ACE HALL, besides Turaya Food Canteen, Yemetu, Ibadan, Oyo State. We are open Monday to Saturday from 9:00 AM, and on the 2nd and last Sunday of the month from 3:00 PM.

q: What are your rates for studio portraits?
a: Standard studio portraits are ₦2,000 per edited picture (Same-day express delivery: +₦500 per picture). Creative concept sessions with custom styling and artistic lighting start from ₦3,000 per picture.

q: Do you travel outside Ibadan for weddings and events?
a: Yes. While our physical studio base is in Yemetu, Ibadan, we regularly shoot in both Ibadan and Lagos, and are available for travel nationwide (and abroad) upon request.

q: What wedding packages do you offer?
a: We offer three full-coverage wedding packages: Essential at ₦180,000 (was ₦200,000), Classic at ₦250,000 (was ₦300,000, our most popular package with photo and highlight video), and Signature Album at ₦450,000 (was ₦550,000, with photo, video, and a 12×24 flush-mount synthetic photobook, 50 designed pages, in a leather presentation briefcase). An album collection can also be added to the Essential or Classic package for ₦180,000.

q: Can I do outfit changes during my studio session?
a: Yes. Our studio provides private changing facilities and mirror space so you can comfortably switch outfits during your booked session time.
